# Appropriation Ordinance No. 01, Series of 2019

**Resolution No. 001**

Supplemental Budget No. 01 — Authorizing a supplemental budget involving a total amount of P3,987,543.76 and an unappropriated balance of P405,329.06, for a grand total of P4,405,329.06.

## Summary

Enacted on July 8, 2019, this appropriation ordinance authorizes Supplemental Budget No. 01 for the [[Municipality of Pitogo]], [[Quezon Province|Quezon]], appropriating a total of P4,405,329.06. The supplemental budget draws from an amount of P3,987,543.76 plus an unappropriated balance of P405,329.06 to fund additional expenditures not covered by the annual budget for CY 2019. The ordinance was introduced by Councilor [[Esperanza A. Tan]] and enacted under the new term of Mayor [[Dexter L. Sayat]], with Vice Mayor [[Paul Timothy C. Villaflor]] presiding over the [[Sangguniang Bayan]].

## Key Provisions

- **Supplemental Appropriation.** Authorizes a supplemental budget totaling P4,405,329.06 for CY 2019.
- **Funding Sources.** Draws from available funds amounting to P3,987,543.76 and an unappropriated balance of P405,329.06.
- **Allocation of Funds.** Distributes supplemental funds across various programs, projects, and activities of the municipal government.
- **Effectivity.** Takes effect upon approval.
